description: This Java source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates embedding a DialogFragment within an activity and showing the dialog upon a button click. It includes a nested static class for the dialog fragment implementation.

classes.name: FragmentDialogOrActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages embedding a dialog fragment and handles button interaction to show the dialog.

classes.name: MyDialogFragment
classes.description: A nested static class extending DialogFragment, providing a simple dialog with a text message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, embeds a dialog fragment, and sets up button click listener.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays the dialog fragment.

methods.name: MyDialogFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment.

methods.name: MyDialogFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the dialog and sets a message in the text view.
